aka.zh: 兰州—磨憨公路（2013 年以前）

tagline.en: From the Mongolian border in the Ejin desert over the Qilian, the Zoigê grasslands and the Min gorge to the Lao border in Xishuangbanna
tagline.zh: 从额济纳荒漠的中蒙边境出发，越祁连山、过若尔盖草原、穿岷江峡谷，直抵西双版纳的中老边境

start.en: Ceke port, Ejin Banner, Alxa League, Inner Mongolia, on the Mongolian border opposite Shivee Khüren
start.zh: 内蒙古自治区阿拉善盟额济纳旗策克口岸，中蒙边境，对应蒙古国西伯库伦口岸

end.en: Mohan port, Mengla county, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan, on the Lao border opposite Boten
end.zh: 云南省西双版纳傣族自治州勐腊县磨憨口岸，中老边境，对应老挝磨丁口岸

en: G213 runs north to south across western China, from Ceke port on the Mongolian border to Mohan port on the Lao border, where it meets Laos's Route 13; Chinese Wikipedia gives its length as 4,136 km. It passes through Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Qinghai, Sichuan and Yunnan. The 2013 national highway plan lists its control points as Ceke, Ejin Banner, Jinta, Jiuquan, Sunan, Qilian, Haiyan, Huangyuan, Xining, Ping'an, Hualong, Jainca, Tongren, Zêkog and Henan county; Zoigê, Songpan, Maoxian, Wenchuan, Dujiangyan, Pixian, Chengdu, Renshou, Jingyan, Qianwei and Muchuan in Sichuan; and Suijiang, Yongshan, Daguan, Zhaotong, Huize, Xundian, Songming, Kunming, Jinning, Yuxi, Eshan, Yuanjiang, Mojiang, Ning'er, Pu'er and Mengla in Yunnan.

From Ejin Banner it comes south to the Hexi Corridor at Jiuquan, crosses the Qilian range to Qilian county and Xining, and runs through the Huangnan Tibetan prefecture of Qinghai and the Aba Tibetan and Qiang prefecture of Sichuan before following the Min River down by Maoxian and Wenchuan to Dujiangyan and Chengdu. South of Chengdu it crosses north-eastern Yunnan by Zhaotong to Kunming, and from Kunming it follows the 1950s Kunming–Daluo road towards Xishuangbanna. The atlas draws it as a single piece between the two border ports.
zh: G213 自北向南纵贯中国西部，起于中蒙边境的策克口岸，止于中老边境的磨憨口岸，出境接老挝 13 号公路；中文维基百科给出的全长为 4136 公里。途经内蒙古、甘肃、青海、四川、云南。2013 年《国家公路网规划》所列主要控制点：策克、额济纳旗、金塔、酒泉、肃南、祁连、海晏、湟源、西宁、平安、化隆、尖扎、同仁、泽库、河南；四川的若尔盖、松潘、茂县、汶川、都江堰、郫县、成都、仁寿、井研、犍为、沐川；云南的绥江、永善、大关、昭通、会泽、寻甸、嵩明、昆明、晋宁、玉溪、峨山、元江、墨江、宁洱、普洱、勐腊。
它自额济纳旗南下，在酒泉进入河西走廊，翻越祁连山至祁连县和西宁，穿过青海黄南藏族自治州和四川阿坝藏族羌族自治州，再沿岷江经茂县、汶川而下，到都江堰和成都。成都以南，它经昭通穿过滇东北到昆明；昆明以南，沿用 20 世纪 50 年代的昆洛公路通往西双版纳。本图集把它绘为两口岸之间的一整段。

en: In north-western Sichuan, the Langmusi–Chuanzhusi road, 223 km from the Gansu boundary at Langmusi in Zoigê county through Hongyuan to Chuanzhusi in Songpan county, runs at an average altitude of 3,500 m, two-thirds of it along the edge of the Zoigê grassland and wetland reserve. It was built mostly to class-II standard for 80 km/h. To protect the grassland, the builders cut the turf beside the road in whole slabs and laid it back on the embankment slopes rather than facing them with concrete. The drive from Chuanzhusi to Zoigê fell from nearly five hours to an hour and a half.

At the northern end, the Dalaihob–Dongfeng Space City section in Ejin Banner, opened in 2022, is 143.39 km of four-lane class-I road for 100 km/h, with a 12.378 km link road to Heicheng. Over most of its length one carriageway is new and the other is the old class-II road rebuilt. North of Dalaihob, the class-I road to Ceke port, 60 km away, is also part of G213.
zh: 川西北的郎木寺至川主寺公路，自川甘交界的若尔盖县郎木寺乡经红原县至松潘县川主寺镇，全长 223 公里，平均海拔 3500 米，三分之二的路线行经若尔盖大草原和湿地保护区边缘，大部按设计时速 80 公里的二级公路标准建设。为保护草原，施工中将路线途经的草甸整块切割，就地回植到路基边坡上，而不用水泥加固。川主寺至若尔盖的行车时间由近 5 小时缩短到 1.5 小时。
北端，2022 年通车的额济纳旗达来呼布至东风航天城段，主线长 143.39 公里，按设计时速 100 公里的双向四车道一级公路建设，另建黑城连接线 12.378 公里。主线大部分路段一幅新建，另一幅利用原二级公路改扩建。达来呼布以北，通往 60 公里外策克口岸的达策一级公路也属 213 国道。

en: The southern end is the oldest. The Kunming–Daluo Highway, to the Burmese border in Xishuangbanna, was begun after a management office was set up in 1951; Zhou Enlai approved its design standards on 24 January 1951, and in September 1952 Mao Zedong and Zhu De wrote inscriptions for its builders. It reached Yuanjiang from Daliyuan in Yuxi in July 1952, Mojiang in August and Pu'er in December; it reached Jinghong in December 1953, where an opening ceremony was held on 16 December, and the 674 km from Daliyuan to Menghai was complete in December 1954, after three years and three months. Today's G213 follows it from Kunming south through Yuxi, Yuanjiang, Mojiang and Pu'er.

Before 2013 the number belonged to the Lanzhou–Mohan road. Its Gansu section, 422.36 km, ran from Lanzhou's central square by Yongjing, Linxia and Hezuo to Langmusi on the Sichuan boundary. In 1992 Gansu put it into a programme to rebuild some 420 km of road: the first phase, more than 300 km, was finished in August 1993, before the 40th anniversary of the Gannan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, and left it broadly at class-II standard; the second, the 159 km from Hezuo to Langmusi, was rebuilt between April and August 1994.

On 12 May 2008 the Wenchuan earthquake destroyed the Dujiangyan–Wenchuan stretch. Of its 90-odd km, 80 per cent was damaged; some 100 million cubic metres of rock and earth came down, more than 10 km of road was buried outright, more than 50 bridges were damaged and seven collapsed. Before the quake about 12,000 vehicles a day used it; afterwards traffic for Wenchuan had to go round by nearly 800 km of mountain road, over two passes above 4,000 m. Experts had expected the repair to take three years; with more than 4,000 workers it reopened on 2 September 2008.

The 2013 national highway plan moved the northern end from Lanzhou to Ceke, adding the sections through Inner Mongolia, the Hexi Corridor and Qinghai. The same plan lists a separate G568 from Lanzhou by Yongjing, Linxia and Hezuo to Luqu, where it meets G213. In Inner Mongolia the Dalaihob–Dongfeng Space City section was begun in 2020 and opened on 12 December 2022.
zh: 南段最早。通往西双版纳中缅边境的昆洛公路，于 1951 年成立昆洛公路管理处后开始修建；1951 年 1 月 24 日，周恩来批准昆洛公路测设标准，1952 年 9 月，毛泽东、朱德为昆洛公路修建题词。1952 年 7 月，玉溪大梨园至元江段通车，8 月通到墨江，12 月通到普洱；1953 年 12 月通到景洪，12 月 16 日在景洪举行通车典礼；1954 年 12 月，大梨园至勐海全长 674 公里全部竣工，历时 3 年零 3 个月。今天的 G213 自昆明南下，经玉溪、元江、墨江、普洱，沿用的就是这条路。
2013 年以前，这个编号属于兰州—磨憨公路。其甘肃段长 422.36 公里，起于兰州市中心广场，经永靖、临夏、合作，由郎木寺出甘入川。1992 年，甘肃省将其纳入约 420 公里的公路改造工程：一期 300 余公里于 1993 年 8 月甘南藏族自治州成立四十周年州庆前完工，改造后基本达到二级公路标准；二期改建合作至郎木寺段 159 公里，1994 年 4 月开工、8 月完工。

2008 年 5 月 12 日，汶川地震摧毁了都江堰至汶川段。90 余公里的都汶公路 80% 损毁，1 亿立方米土石塌方，10 多公里路段被崩塌的山体完全覆盖，50 余座桥梁受损、7 座完全垮塌。地震前每天有 1.2 万辆机动车往返；震后进出汶川需绕行近 800 公里山路，途中要翻越两座海拔 4000 余米的大山。专家曾预计恢复通车至少需要 3 年；4000 多名施工人员奋战三个多月，2008 年 9 月 2 日全线贯通、恢复通车。
2013 年《国家公路网规划》将北端起点由兰州改为策克，增加了经内蒙古、河西走廊和青海的路段。同一规划另列 G568 兰州—碌曲，经永靖、临夏、合作至碌曲，与 G213 相接。内蒙古境内，达来呼布至东风航天城段于 2020 年全面开工，2022 年 12 月 12 日通车运营。

en: No cost has been published for the whole road. Published section figures include 20.13 million yuan for the 159 km Hezuo–Langmusi rebuild of 1994 and 21.21 million for the 76 km Tumenguan–Hezuo rebuild of 1993 in Gansu; 1.779 billion for the 223 km Langmusi–Chuanzhusi road in Sichuan, opened in 2007; and about 2.642 billion for the Dalaihob–Dongfeng Space City section in Inner Mongolia, opened in 2022.

The Inner Mongolian section was the first class-I road in Ejin Banner built as a public–private partnership. Its tender notice gives the funding as central vehicle-purchase-tax money equal to 30 per cent of the static investment, with the rest borrowed from banks by the project company; it is tolled at Heicheng and Dongfeng.
zh: 全线没有公布过总造价。已公布的分段数字包括：甘肃 1994 年合作至郎木寺段 159 公里改建投资 2013 万元，1993 年土门关至合作段 76 公里改建投资 2121 万元；四川 2007 年建成的郎木寺至川主寺公路 223 公里总投资 17.79 亿元；内蒙古 2022 年通车的达来呼布至东风航天城段总投资约 26.42 亿元。
内蒙古这一段是额济纳旗首条采用 PPP 模式建设的一级公路。招标公告列明，建设资金来自按静态投资 30% 申请的国家中央车购税，其余由项目公司向银行贷款；全线设黑城、东风两座收费站。

en: The Langmusi–Chuanzhusi stretch averages 3,500 m above sea level. Between Dujiangyan and Wenchuan the road runs with the mountainside on one side and the Min River on the other. At the two ends it serves busy border ports: Ceke is Inner Mongolia's second-largest coal-import port, and Mohan is the end of the Chinese part of the Kunming–Bangkok international corridor.
zh: 郎木寺至川主寺段平均海拔 3500 米。都江堰至汶川段一边是山，一边是岷江。两端各连一座繁忙的边境口岸：策克是内蒙古第二大煤炭进口口岸，磨憨则是昆明—曼谷国际大通道中国段的终点。

why.en: No route-wide figure exists. G213 has been built and rebuilt by five provinces section by section since the 1950s; the published section costs are listed below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价。G213 自 20 世纪 50 年代起由沿线五省区分段修建、改建；已公布的分段造价分列于下。

value.en: Section by section. Dalaihob–Dongfeng Space City (2022): public–private partnership, with central vehicle-purchase-tax money for 30 per cent of the static investment and bank loans to the project company for the rest. No route-wide statement exists.
value.zh: 分段筹资。达来呼布至东风航天城段（2022 年）：PPP 模式，按静态投资 30% 申请国家中央车购税，其余由项目公司银行贷款。未见全线出资说明。

timeline.en: Zhou Enlai approves the design standards of the Kunming–Daluo Highway on 24 January; a management office is set up to build it.
timeline.zh: 1 月 24 日，周恩来批准昆洛公路测设标准；昆洛公路管理处成立，开始修建。

timeline.en: The Kunming–Daluo road reaches Yuanjiang in July, Mojiang in August and Pu'er in December.
timeline.zh: 昆洛公路 7 月通到元江，8 月通到墨江，12 月通到普洱。

timeline.en: An opening ceremony is held at Jinghong on 16 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 16 日，在景洪举行昆洛公路通车典礼。

timeline.en: The 674 km from Daliyuan to Menghai is complete in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，大梨园至勐海 674 公里全部竣工。

timeline.en: The first phase of Gansu's rebuild of the Lanzhou–Langmusi road is finished in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，甘肃兰郎公路改造一期工程完工。

timeline.en: Hezuo to Langmusi, 159 km, is rebuilt between April and August.
timeline.zh: 4 月至 8 月，合作至郎木寺段 159 公里改建完成。

timeline.en: Work on the Langmusi–Chuanzhusi road begins on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 28 日，郎木寺至川主寺公路改建工程开工。

timeline.en: The Langmusi–Chuanzhusi road is completed on 25 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 25 日，郎木寺至川主寺公路全线竣工通车。

timeline.en: The Wenchuan earthquake of 12 May wrecks the Dujiangyan–Wenchuan road; it reopens on 2 September.
timeline.zh: 5 月 12 日汶川地震摧毁都汶公路；9 月 2 日全线贯通、恢复通车。

timeline.en: The national highway plan moves the northern end from Lanzhou to Ceke.
timeline.zh: 《国家公路网规划》将北端起点由兰州改为策克。

timeline.en: The Dalaihob–Dongfeng Space City section opens on 12 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 12 日，达来呼布至东风航天城段通车运营。
